summary: Thriving on the terraces where hot-spring runoff cools below 70 °C, this dense microbial mat couples photosynthesis with sulfur oxidation (D22). Its black base captures the dense air’s diffused light (F4), while red-purple surface pigments screen the high-altitude UV flux (F14, D23). It converts vent gases and solar photons into lipid-rich filaments, sustaining specialized grazers and decomposers in an otherwise barren zone (D28).

links: Why: Vent gases provide continuous chemical energy alongside solar photons
Why: Dense, humid air traps volatiles near the ground (F16)
chains.play: Gift: Raw sulfur crusts grant +8 metabolism and temporary heat resistance.
chains.weakness: Vulnerable to sudden cooling: frost or heavy rain collapses the mat structure.
observe: Sosa herds scrape layers with keratinous beaks
Red capillary veins pulse with sulfuric acid

plausibility.summary: Black microbial mats below ~70 °C on vent runoff, mixing light capture and sulfur chemistry, align with F23/D22 and existing costra_de_azufre logic. Dense humid air (F4, F16) slows drying; lipid-rich mats support specialist grazers (sosa).
fixes: Replace “sulfur-oxidising chloroplasts” with a stratified mat or syncyanosis: oxygenic phototrophs in the upper millimetres, sulfur oxidisers in the interior—eukaryotic plastids do not run sulfur oxidation. Soften “veins pulse with sulfuric acid” to buffered low pH at the surface. Gift link to corteza_de_azufre should distinguish this mixotroph from pure chemosynthetic crust.

analogues.mechanism: Layered communities combine anoxygenic or oxygenic photosynthesis with sulfur cycling along thermal and chemical gradients (Castenholz, 1973, from memory, unverified).

links: Why: Extracellular polysaccharides bind the mat to hot rock
Why: Dense air slows evaporation, reducing water loss (F4, F16)
chains.play: Gift: Kaolin clay or salt licks calm the creature nearby and reveal hidden nutrient caches.
chains.weakness: Acidic pools near vents dissolve the mucilage, exposing the photosynthetic layer to burnout.
observe: Surface shimmers with iridescent oil slicks
Decomposers cluster where mat fragments detach
Heat haze distorts vision above dense clusters

colour.base: Deep black with crimson surface veins. The black base maximizes photon capture in the dense, foggy vent air (F4) and shields against high UV (D23), while the red-purple carotenoids reflect excess radiation and optimize photosynthesis in the narrow yellow-green window (D24).
